field_hash.cross_stage_integrity: Each stage must contain exactly 768 hashes, each stage set must have cardinality 768, and the union of all three domain-separated stage sets must have cardinality 2304. Any missing hash, within-stage duplicate, cross-stage digest reuse, stage-label/tag mismatch, or hash swap is a full technical integrity failure with no estimator or scientific result.
field_hash.field_persistence: The three full fields are ephemeral and forbidden outputs. Retain only framed SHA-256, fixed framing metadata, reference_index, and the independent streaming-check receipt after each live array is released.

frame.byte_formula: UTF8(stage_domain_tag) || 0x00 || ASCII('field-frame-v1') || 0x00 || ASCII('<f4') || 0x00 || uint32_be(3) || uint64_be(192) || uint64_be(192) || uint64_be(192) || uint64_be(28311552) || payload
frame.dtype: exact NumPy dtype <f4: IEEE-754 binary32 little-endian; a native/big-endian source is converted once to <f4 before hashing and that exact canonical array must be the stage consumer input
frame.hash_scope: Every byte from the first domain-tag byte through the final payload byte is included; there is no trailing newline, length omission, JSON representation, compression, or salt.
frame.nan_and_infinity_policy: Every one of the 7,077,888 binary32 payload elements must be finite before framing. NaN, positive infinity, or negative infinity is a full technical integrity failure; NaN payload canonicalization is forbidden. Finite signed-zero and subnormal bit patterns are preserved exactly.
frame.payload: Exactly 28,311,552 bytes from np.ascontiguousarray(stage_array,dtype=np.dtype('<f4')).tobytes(order='C'); no transpose, Fortran order, padding, byte swap after conversion, mean adjustment, or serialization copy with changed values.
frame.shape_encoding: ndim is unsigned 32-bit big-endian value 3; each dimension and payload byte count is unsigned 64-bit big-endian in the stated order

per_member_fields.consumer_binding: The exact canonical <f4 C-order cube passed as the whitened input to make_forward; hash immediately before jnp.asarray/forward consumption.
The exact canonical <f4 C-order pmwd.scatter z=0 density cube before gaussian_filter, mean normalization, or delta conversion; hash immediately after device-to-host completion and before smoothing.

The exact canonical <f4 C-order delta cube supplied to score_member. Hash immediately before scoring and again after scoring; both hashes and the streaming checker hash must equal smoothed_delta_scorer_input_sha256, proving the scored bytes and bound digest are identical and unmodified.

streaming_independent_checker.handoff: At each of the three live stage boundaries, the producer and an independently implemented checker-side framer each receive a read-only view of the same canonical <f4 C-order array and independently compute the full framed SHA-256. The row cannot advance unless the two digests, frame metadata, stage tag, reference_index, and expected consumer binding agree exactly.
streaming_independent_checker.independence: Producer and checker framing implementations may share only this frozen declarative contract and standard hashlib/struct/NumPy primitives; they may not share framing helpers, constants assembled in code, digest rows, or mutable buffers.
streaming_independent_checker.retention: After exact comparison, retain the digest and minimal receipt only; do not persist, checkpoint, cache, memory-map, or serialize the field payload. Release each initial/density field as soon as its consumer completes and release scorer input after the identical post-score hash.
streaming_independent_checker.sealed_recheck: The final independent output checker verifies exact 768-row coverage, receipt identity, field-name/domain-tag/frame metadata, three per-row digests, each 768-unique stage set, 2304-unique union, and exact binding to seed/reference/scorer rows without rerunning PM or trusting producer aggregation helpers.

initial_condition_generator.Gaussian_normalization: Exactly 192^3 independent N(0,1) real-space variates from PCG64 standard_normal; no sample-mean subtraction, variance rescaling, clipping, phase pairing, constrained mode, or antithetic member
initial_condition_generator.exact_operation: np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(seed_uint64)).standard_normal(size=(192,192,192), dtype=np.float64), then astype(np.float32) once; this is the unconstrained xi draw used by the current posterior without the subsequent CF4 Matheron conditioning term
initial_condition_generator.fourier_and_Hermitian_convention: No Fourier coefficients are sampled directly and no Fourier edit occurs at IC generation. The real spatial cube therefore has the exact Hermitian rFFT implied by a real array. pmwd.linear_modes applies its orthonormal real-field FFT and multiplies by sqrt(P_linear(k)*L^3).
initial_condition_generator.invalid_seed_avoidance: seed_uint64 is decoded from exactly eight SHA-256 digest bytes and is therefore always in the closed NumPy PCG64 seed range [0,2^64-1]; JAX key words are decoded as two uint32 words and are always valid. No counter, salt, modulo repair, rejection sampling, or replacement is permitted.

initial_condition_generator.zero_mode: The sampled real-space field is not forced to zero mean; its sampled DC is retained as input. No manual DC edit is allowed. The linear-density k=0 behavior is solely the pinned pmwd.linear_modes transfer convention.

purpose: Seal corrected forbidden inventories and exactly 768 prospective reference seeds before any IC, field, PM, implementation, grant, or execution.

contract.collision_policy: All 768 full digests, seed_uint64 values, and jax_key_words pairs must be internally unique and exactly disjoint from the authoritative forbidden inventories. Any internal or forbidden collision makes design version v1 INVALID before IC generation. Counter extension, salt change, modulo repair, rejection, redraw, retry, replacement, index extension, or alternate digest-byte selection is forbidden.
contract.generator_seed_use: Only seed_uint64 initializes np.random.PCG64 for the frozen IC generator. jax_key_words is a required collision/audit encoding and is not consumed by the PM forward, which receives the already generated float32 real-space field.
inventory_preseal_forbidden: enumerating any of the 768 digests or integer seeds
creating a partial, trial, candidate, backup, or alternative inventory
using a parent/tree/worktree hash or a guessed future commit
drawing random seeds outside the formula
searching seed values for P1 performance
contract.jax_key_words: exact ordered pair [uint32_be(digest bytes 0..3), uint32_be(digest bytes 4..7)]; no folding, swapping, signed cast, legacy PRNGKey conversion, or alternate digest bytes
prospective_resolution_rule: First obtain separate authorization to commit only this design record.
After that commit exists, independently audit and record its full 40-hex commit and the SHA256 of the committed design blob.

Only a separately authorized future seed-manifest design/record may evaluate the formula for indices 0..767, independently materialize the SHA-pinned forbidden inventories, and bind every full digest, seed_uint64, JAX key pair, exact empty intersections, design commit, and design SHA256.
The seed inventory becomes immutable only when that future seed manifest is committed and independently audited.
contract.seed_uint64: unsigned big-endian integer from digest bytes 0..7

typed_rule.container_order: Mappings traverse keys in Unicode code-point ascending order; arrays traverse increasing zero-based index; every provenance location is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer.
typed_rule.integer_array: If such a seed-key value is an array consisting only of JSON integers excluding Boolean, apply the exact range rule if named below; otherwise extract every element in array order.
typed_rule.integer_leaf: Extract a JSON integer, excluding Boolean, only when its immediate mapping key has a case-sensitive underscore-delimited token seed or seeds. Every extracted integer must be in [0,2^64-1] or the source closes design v1 INVALID.
typed_rule.jax_keys: Only an explicitly schema-declared jax_key_words/key_data array with final shape 2 and uint32 elements is a JAX pair. Additionally each legacy extracted scalar seed in [0,2^32-1] contributes the conservative legacy JAX PRNGKey pair [0,seed]. No unrelated geometry keys are paired.
typed_rule.npz: Load with allow_pickle=false; only exact arrays/selectors listed for that SHA-pinned source are read; signed/unsigned integer values normalize exactly to mathematical integers before range validation.
range_rules: *_seed_range_inclusive or *_seeds_range_inclusive=[lo,hi] expands every integer lo..hi inclusive
Within a mapping containing integer count=C, each *_seed_start=S expands S..S+C-1; count itself is not a seed
No integer is inferred from strings, free text, path names, schema names, Boolean-key names, floating values, or unlisted NPZ arrays
typed_rule.uniqueness: Retain complete per-occurrence provenance first, then sort and deduplicate only for the two set inventories and their digests.
